units.title: Arrays and Linked Lists
learning_outcomes: Implement linear data structures such as linked lists and stacks
Analyze time complexity of basic data structure operations

units.title: Stacks and Queues
learning_outcomes: Apply stacks and queues to solve parsing and scheduling problems
Differentiate between linear and circular queue mechanisms

units.title: Trees and Binary Search Trees
topics: Binary Search Trees (BST) insertion and deletion
learning_outcomes: Design and implement hierarchical data structures

units.title: Graph Algorithms
topics: Graph representations: Adjacency Matrix and Adjacency List
Minimum Spanning Trees: Prim's and Kruskal's algorithms
learning_outcomes: Analyze graph traversal techniques and connectivity
Formulate shortest-path and minimum spanning tree solutions

units.title: Dynamic Programming & Optimization
topics: Principles of Dynamic Programming vs Divide & Conquer
learning_outcomes: Apply dynamic programming methods to optimization problems
Analyze asymptotic recurrence relations and optimal solutions
